notes: The whose of whose name was Manoah is given to the possessive suffix under rule 18 and the waw left unrepresented under rule 17.
מִשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי is rendered arthrously (*the family of the Danites*), so nothing is fronted: the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct a supplied one (rule 29).
